items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was an open-air theater where we played a concert on the same bill with Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: It was an open-air theater where we played a concert on the same bill with Louis Armstrong. What was so great about Washington and Chicago was Basie fans invited us into their homes for dinners, parties, or what have you. The whole time we were there they played our own records for us.
I guess this was after the Howard Theater was doing much jazz. Do you remember doing the Howard Theater?
